newsitem.title: USA: Sabratek files for 2.2 mln share offering.
newsitem.headline: Sabratek files for 2.2 mln share offering.

text.p: Sabratek Corp said Monday it filed a registration statement for the sale by the company of 1.7 million shares of its common stock and the sale by certain selling stockholders of 532,028 shares of common shares.
In addition, the company will grant underwriters a 30-day option to buy up to 334,804 additional shares to cover overallotments.
Sabratek will use proceeds for working capital and other general corporate purposses that may include expanding manufacturing capabilities, sales and marketing efforts.
Sabratek develops, produces and markets interactive therapeutic and diagnostic medical systems designed to meet the needs of the alternative-site healthcare market.
